section_summary.extract_value: The section reports that Zimbabwean women in Britain showed significantly greater weight discrepancy than their peers in Zimbabwe; this is attributed to migrants perceiving their current body size as larger and desiring a smaller size. It also notes women in Britain believed men idealized a thinner body and that the migrant group perceived the typical female body size as larger. The text references Table 1 and does not provide sample sizes or methodological details.
